summary: All log links now share one #log-drawer-body swap target with no hx-sync/abort or request-sequence guard. handleLogs can block up to refreshTimeout (30s), so opening run A then run B before A returns can let A's slower response arrive last and overwrite B in the drawer, showing the wrong run's log; the previous per-run inline targets did not have this cross-run race. Add request serialization/abort or discard stale responses before swap.
